message.content: On guidance management now expects fourth fiscal quarter 2026 revenue to be in the range of $1.930 billion to $1.950 billion with a mid-point representing year-over-year growth of approximately 37 percent, which represents an improvement from the prior outlook that projected third fiscal quarter 2026 revenue between $1.730 billion and $1.750 billion with a mid-point representing year-over-year growth of approximately 29 percent [D1] [D2]. What is working includes record Q3 results reflecting the growing relevance of our strategy and portfolio, which is enabling customers to solve complex engineering challenges across our end markets [D1], strong momentum in commercial communications showing 56 percent growth alongside 14 percent growth in aerospace, defense, and government within the Communications Solutions Group [D1], double-digit growth across all end markets of automotive and energy, general electronics, and semiconductor within the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group [D2], and a robust pipeline of opportunities supporting the company's ability to capitalize on accelerating demand [D2]. What is not working includes certain items impacting the GAAP tax rate pertaining to future events that are not currently estimable with a reasonable degree of accuracy [D1], the exclusion of acquisition-related items such as amortization of acquired intangible assets and legal costs from non-GAAP measures due to their non-cash or non-recurring nature [D1], share-based compensation expense which is primarily a non-cash charge varying significantly based on share price and equity awards granted [D1], and restructuring initiatives aimed at material changes in the business or cost structure that are excluded from non-GAAP financial measures as they are not normal recurring operating expenses [D1].
